title: Ikizamini cy'Ikiremwa Gitagatifu
intro: Ikimenyetso cyoherejwe ku ishyanga ryari ryarayobye. Hagati mu buzima bwabo bwiza haje umuburo—uherekejwe n'ikiremwa gitangaje cyari kuzaba ikizamini cy'ukwemera kwabo. Igisubizo cyabo cyari guhamya iherezo ryabo iteka ryose. Ese ushobora kumenya uwatanze uyu muburo n'icyabaye ku banze kuwutanga?
clues: Twari abantu bari barayobowe n'intumwa zatubanjirije.
Ikiremwa gitangaje cyavuye ku musozi, ikimenyetso cy'Umwami wacu kuri iki gihugu.
Narababwiye nti: 'Iyi ni ingamiya y'ingore y'Imana, nimuyireke irye ku butaka bw'Imana kandi ntimuyigireho ingaruka mbi.'
Ariko abantu baciye ingamiya yanjye y'ingore ibitsi, birengagiza itegeko ry'Umwami wabo.
Ndi intumwa iturutse ku Mwami wawe gusa, yoherejwe n'ukuri—ndi umuhanuzi n'umugaragu wiringirwa.
Ku byerekeye abakora ibibi, Umwami wacu yabakubise urusaku rw'inkuba, maze bahagarara mu ngo zabo.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verse: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen. (54:31)
